answer: To trade, an account must stake ten dollars and register a device key via a juniper gateway, publishing its fingerprint. A comet of accounts sharing a fingerprint, or created minutes apart, triggers review by three auditors within two days, who verify the signed deposit receipt and device attestation. A forged attestation forfeits the stake and blocks it. One honest user risks ten dollars; one thousand fakes cost ten thousand dollars plus one thousand devices, so a raven operator with cloned phones loses a deposit per copy and gains no access.
